population.kidComparison: About 21 million people live in Chad—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Inland terrain bordered by neighboring countries.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Chad
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Chad.

exploration.didYouKnow: Chad is located in Middle Africa and its capital city is N'Djamena.
